covers.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished portrait comic book cover, 1024x1536 preferred. Title exactly "DRAIN DAMAGE" across top in large bold readable lettering, small "ISSUE 01" upper corner. No other text or subtitle. Same scene for a seven-style comparison: two recognizable adult human plumber heroes standing together in a flooded luxury hotel wedding ballroom. Tony on left, Sean on right, both three-quarter full bodies prominent center. Tony aims a hose nozzle connected to a compact backpack jetter, water blasting diagonally toward a hostile porcelain toilet monster in lower left; Sean braces a long wooden-handled red rubber plunger against another lunging toilet monster lower right. Heroes have believable adult proportions, complete arms/hands with correct grip, natural expression of alarm and determination with dry humor. White porcelain monsters have angry eyes, bowl mouths with teeth, cistern backs and little limbs. Lavish chandelier and wedding flowers behind, cake and champagne knocked askew by water, panicked wedding guests small in distance. Small detail near foreground edge: a leaking plumbing pipe poorly repaired with gold paint and a decorative wedding ribbon. No game bosses, portals, spoilers, gore, sunglasses, baby costumes, ripped costumes, animals, chibi or oversized heads.
Reference1 is canonical Tony identity: dark spiky hair, strong brows, young-adult face, navy work shirt, teal work trousers, brown boots/tool belt. Reference2 canonical Sean identity: bald adult, original forehead/eyes/nose/jaw, gray chin beard+soul patch, no full cheek beard or prominent moustache, orange shirt and blue denim overalls, brown work boots; stocky normal adult, NOT short/chibi or hypermuscular. Preserve both specific likenesses while translating to requested medium. Upper 15% title safe area. Dynamic triangular composition, convincing anatomy and perspective, rich environment, polished original cover illustration.
RENDERING DIRECTION: Full-color grotesque pulp horror-comedy. Powerful expressive black ink, dimensional adult faces and anatomy, grimy densely textured surfaces, visceral porcelain monsters. Rich dirty amber/teal/red colors, halftone print character, dramatic danger mixed with absurd comedy. Sophisticated detailed illustration, not simplified cartoon.
